ABOUT ME

How I work

I like working through the small decisions that make a flow easier to use. Can someone tell why their search results changed? Can they fix an order before paying? I use wireframes to work through those questions and usability testing to see where people still get stuck.

I’m pursuing my M.S. in Graphic Information Technology at Arizona State University, where I earned my B.S. with a focus in UX.

I’m looking for an early-career UX or product design role where I can work through design decisions with teammates and see the details through to implementation. I’m especially interested in how people learn to use new technology, including vehicle automation.
